surfaces.name: loushang CLI and terminal workbench (loushang code, TUI, rpc/json modes, lmux)
HarnessGUI Tauri desktop shell and loopback web server (source-built)

claims.answer: Terminal CLI/TUI (`loushang`, Python) is the primary client; a Tauri 2/React desktop shell and a loopback-only browser server over a separate AppHost exist in the repository but have no published installers; no mobile app, phone layout or editor extension.

scope.version: default-branch commit cb54b4b (2026-11-16); no published releases; pyproject version 0.1.0

desktop_os.answer: Tauri bundle target "all" with Windows source-dev steps documented and Linux installed packages mentioned, but no release or installer exists and macOS is not described beyond icon assets.

mobile_apps.answer: Bounded search finds no iOS or Android client.

browser.answer: A standalone Rust web server serves the same React app on 127.0.0.1:1422 with no login; built from source; remote deployment deferred.

mobile_browser.answer: The browser server is loopback-by-default (bind configurable) with no authentication; docs defer remote deployment, so no supported phone path is documented.

cli.answer: `loushang` CLI/TUI with print, json and rpc modes, plus loushang-tui, loushang-mux and lmux entry points.

editor_extensions.answer: Bounded search for vscode, vsix, jetbrains, neovim and ACP finds none.

task_actions.answer: TUI supports prompting, steering/follow-up queues, approvals, session resume and fork; GUI renders conversation with a read-only diff view; method steps are not in TUI/RPC.

notifications.answer: No notification mechanism found in CLI; GUI notification locale strings exist but docs state tray/notification behaviour is not implemented.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Sessions persist on the host and can be resumed; lmux reattaches over SSH on the same Linux machine; the GUI connects to a local AppHost only.

limitations: Desktop and browser GUIs are built from source (no release artifacts) and the browser server listens on loopback with no login.
No installable mobile app or editor extension.

claims.answer: Loushang embeds its own agent loop and model layer (`loushang.agent`, `loushang.ai`); it does not launch third-party coding CLIs. Twelve model providers across OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi Code, Qwen, GLM, MiniMax, Volcano Ark, Hunyuan, Qianfan and StepFun routes.

scope.version: default-branch commit cb54b4b (2026-11-16); no published releases; pyproject version 0.1.0

harnesses.answer: Only Loushang's own embedded harness; no Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or other external harness adapter.

model_providers.answer: Catalog lists twelve providers with endpoint variants (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi Code, DashScope, MiniMax, Z.AI, Volcano Ark, Hunyuan, Qianfan, StepFun).

custom_adapters.answer: Project/user model catalogs under .loushang/models/ and SDK provider registration add custom endpoints; Python extensions add tools.

session_integration.answer: Embedded harness: Loushang runs the model loop itself over provider APIs; it does not drive an external CLI.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: Only one harness exists, so mixed-harness operation is not possible; per-role models can differ in recipes.

limitations: One embedded harness only; no external coding-agent adapters.

claims.answer: API keys from provider environment variables are the supported route; an experimental importer reuses an existing Codex CLI login file for the OpenAI coding-responses endpoint; no vendor credits and no local model runtime documented.

scope.version: default-branch commit cb54b4b (2026-11-16); no published releases; pyproject version 0.1.0

agent_subscriptions.answer: Only an experimental importer for an existing Codex CLI login (~/.codex/auth.json) on the openai coding-responses endpoint; Coding itself no longer owns OAuth login.

api_accounts.answer: Provider API keys read from catalog-declared environment variables (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); .env not loaded.

vendor_credits.answer: The project sells no credits or tokens; the model gateway is roadmap V3.

local_models.answer: Custom catalog entries can point at any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible base URL, which could be local, but no local runtime or Ollama preset ships.

account_switching.answer: Per-invocation --model provider:endpoint:model selects among configured credentials; no multi-account switcher per provider.

vendor_account_requirement.answer: No Loushang account is required; only a model provider credential for online runs.

provider_restrictions.answer: Provider terms on third-party use of subscriptions are not documented by Loushang.

limitations: OpenAI OAuth route is experimental, imports an existing Codex file credential and cannot refresh.
No bring-your-own-subscription support for Anthropic or other providers.
claims.unknownReason: Provider-side terms for subscription reuse are external business/policy facts not stated in the repository.

claims.answer: Install from source with uv (Python 3.11+), export a provider key, run `loushang -p ...`; works in any directory, with or without Git; no remote or managed-cloud onboarding.

scope.version: default-branch commit cb54b4b (2026-11-16); no published releases; pyproject version 0.1.0

first_task_setup.answer: Documented path: git clone, uv venv, uv pip install -e ".[dev]", export API key, `loushang -p`.

no_git.answer: The CLI runs in the current directory; workspace registration is by path and Git is needed only for isolated worktrees.

local_git_without_remote.answer: Git workspace manager works on local repositories without any remote; no remote is required.

hosted_git.answer: No GitHub/GitLab integration; a hosted repository is just a clone the agent works in via git commands.

prerequisite_guidance.answer: Requirements list Python 3.11+, a provider credential and a terminal; GUI toolchain pins Node 24, npm 11, Rust 1.98.1.

managed_cloud_setup.answer: No managed cloud exists; roadmap V5 only.

byo_vps_onboarding.answer: A user can run the CLI over SSH or a systemd user unit for AppHost, but no installer or guided VPS onboarding exists.

limitations: No packaged installer or release; first-run is a manual source install.
Git-backed workspace isolation needs a Git repository.

claims.answer: Rich CLI (print/json/rpc modes, list/export/diagnostic commands), a JSONL RPC channel, a Python SDK (`loushang.ai`, agent and coding APIs), a foreground stdio hosted app and an authenticated AppServer protocol; no MCP server, REST API or webhooks.

mcp_server.answer: Bounded search finds no MCP server.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pull request and deploy workflow
evidence.locator: grep for create_pull_request, pull_request, gh pr create, deploy, release publish across src/ and gui/src
evidence.finding: No pull-request creation, merge, release or deploy implementation; GitHub appears only in the release-asset downloader and effect detection.

evidence.title: Bounded search: collaboration and enterprise controls
evidence.locator: grep for rbac, role_id, organization, membership, sso, saml, oidc, presence, co-prompt, share link across src/, gui/, docs/en
evidence.finding: No multi-user accounts, roles, SSO, presence or shared-prompt implementation; GUI states account authentication is not implemented yet; roadmap V4 lists team workflows as future.

evidence.title: Bounded search: hosted or managed runtime
evidence.locator: grep for vendor cloud, managed runtime provisioning, docker, container image, microvm across src/, gui/, scripts/
evidence.finding: No vendor cloud, container or VM isolation implementation; execution is on the user machine or a host the user starts.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry transmission
evidence.locator: grep for telemetry, analytics, sentry, posthog, otel, opentelemetry, segment.io, mixpanel across src/, gui/, scripts/
evidence.finding: Only the enable_install_telemetry setting and an arch-cache telemetry flag are present; no outbound analytics client was found.

evidence.title: Bounded search: unattended triggers
evidence.locator: grep for cron, crontab, schedule_task, scheduled prompt, webhook, file watcher trigger across src/ and gui/
evidence.finding: No cron/scheduled-task, webhook or event-trigger feature; "schedule" matches are the TUI render scheduler and runtime scheduling internals.

evidence.title: Bounded search: memory and knowledge
evidence.locator: grep for long-term memory, memory store, embeddings, vector, rag, semantic index across src/loushang/coding, harness, gui
evidence.finding: No cross-session memory store, embeddings index or RAG; ontology/storage/memory.py is an in-memory ontology test store. LSP/arch tools give symbol and import-graph queries.

evidence.title: Repository releases check
evidence.finding: The releases API returns zero releases; only two archive/* git tags exist; version 0.1.0 in pyproject.
